name: Crumble
description: A block crumbling at the corners, the noise coarse enough to take chunks out.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 10%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); filter: @svg-filter(feTurbulence { type: fractalNoise; baseFrequency: 0.03; numOctaves: 2; seed: 13 } feDisplacementMap { in: SourceGraphic; scale: 20 }); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
